# Purpose

- Brief description of the purpose of the examination and relevant background if needed

# Scope

- Who performs the examination
- Which participants are examined, and at what point in the study the examination is performed
- Any requirements regarding e.g. fasting, timing, or rest
- Required qualifications/training of personnel performing the examination

# Equipment and Preparation

- Equipment and materials used
- Preparation of equipment, room, and participant prior to the examination

# Safety

- Relevant safety considerations
- Contraindications
- Conditions requiring the examination to be discontinued

# Data

- What data is generated
- Where and how data is registered or stored

# Instructions

- Any standardized instructions to be given to the participant

# Procedure

- Describe the examination step by step - supplement with images if relevant
- Divide into phases if necessary
  - Preparation
    - Step 1
    - Step 2
  - Execution
    - Step 1
    - Step 2
  - Completion
    - Step 1
    - Step 2

# Documentation and Quality Control

- Any checks and documentation to be carried out during and after the examination

# Deviations, Errors, and Equipment Malfunction

- Expected results (what a normal/valid measurement looks like)
- Actions to take in case of deviations or technical issues
- Relevant contact persons

# References

- Related SOPs, protocols, or literature this SOP is based on
